tha-ap319:1.1: samattaṃ. [317. Saddasaññaka.] Sudassano mahāvīro deseti amataṃ padaṃ / parivuto sāvakehi vasati ghara-m-uttame. // //
tha-ap319:2.1: Tāya vācāya madhurāya saṅgaṇhanta-mahājanaṃ / ghoso ca vipulo āsi sadevamānusena
tha-ap319:3.1: so. // // Nigghosasaddaṃ sutvāna Siddhatthassa mahesino / sadde cittaṃ pasādetvā avandiṃ lokanāyakaṃ. // //
tha-ap319:4.1: Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ saññam alabhiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhasaññāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap319:6.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Saddasaññako thero i. g. a-ti.
